overview.zh: 加密与AI同日承压：交易所遭黑客攻击、监管传票与IPO推进并行，行业在扩张与问责之间拉扯。 AI资本：彭博社称Anthropic最早11月中旬启动IPO，10月14日在旧金山会见潜在投资者，部分投资者给出约1.8万亿至2万亿美元估值区间。 加密：Bitget 黑客事件重演了熟悉的模式 监管问责：加州总检察长邦塔10月1日宣布已向OpenAI送达调查性传票，涉及其模型相关网络安全事件，包括Hugging Face被入侵事件。
overview.en: Crypto and AI face the same day of expansion and accountability, as exchange hacks, regulatory subpoenas and IPO plans advance together. AI capital：Bloomberg reported Anthropic seeks to list as early as mid-November, meeting potential investors Oct. 14, with some citing a $1.8 trillion to $2 trillion valuation range. Crypto：The Bitget Hack Repeats a Familiar Pattern

title.zh: 【彭博社：Anthropic 最早 11 月中旬启动 IPO，10 月 14 日拟会见潜在投资者】
title.en: Bloomberg: Anthropic to launch IPO as early as mid-November, plans to meet potential investors on October 14

summary.zh:
据彭博社援引知情人士报道，Anthropic 正寻求最早于 11 月中旬上市，并可能在 11 月 9 日当周启动 IPO 正式营销，目标是在 11 月 26 日感恩节前开始交易，最迟预计于年底前完成上市。知情人士称，公司计划于 10 月 14 日在其旧金山总部会见潜在投资者。

报道称，部分潜在投资者认为 Anthropic 的合理估值区间约为 1.8 万亿至 2 万亿美元，公司预计 IPO 规模可达到或超过 SpaceX，这使该笔上市交易处于近期资本市场事件的高位区间。

报道提到 Anthropic 2025 年营收约 46 亿美元，高于 2024 年的 3.86 亿美元；净亏损接近 420 亿美元，其中超过 340 亿美元来自负债公允价值变动，经营亏损超过 80 亿美元。上述计划、估值区间与时间表均来自匿名知情人士，未获 Anthropic 确认。
summary.en:
Bloomberg reported, citing people familiar with the matter, that Anthropic is seeking to go public as early as mid-November, potentially starting formal IPO marketing in the week of November 9 with the aim of beginning trading before Thanksgiving on November 26, or by the end of the year at the latest. The company plans to meet potential investors at its San Francisco headquarters on October 14.

According to the report, some potential investors view a fair valuation range of roughly $1.8 trillion to $2 trillion, and the company expects the offering could match or exceed SpaceX's — putting a frontier AI lab's listing at the high end of recent capital-markets events.

The report cites about $4.6 billion in 2025 revenue, up from $386 million in 2024, alongside a net loss of nearly $42 billion — more than $34 billion of which stems from fair value changes on liabilities — and an operating loss of more than $8 billion. The plans, valuation range and timing all come from unnamed sources and have not been confirmed by Anthropic.

title.zh: Bitget 黑客事件重演了熟悉的模式
title.en: The Bitget Hack Repeats a Familiar Pattern

summary.zh:
Galaxy Research 发布分析称，Bitget 交易所遭黑客攻击一事，与此前 Bybit 被盗事件呈现出相同的作案模式，而 Bybit 事件被指与朝鲜 Lazarus 集团有关。该分析将 Bitget 事件定性为这一模板的再次重演，而非孤立事件。

按照 Galaxy Research 的评估，将 Bitget 事件与 Lazarus 相关的 Bybit 事件归入同一作案模式，意味着这是一起针对大型交易所的国家支持型入侵。

关于 Bitget 被盗事件的报道提到，从热钱包中被转走的金额约为 3.516 亿美元；CEO 陈格蕾（Gracy Chen）表示用户资金安全，交易所已暂停提现，并称她将 2025 年 Bybit 被盗事件视为“很好的参照”，指出仅有小部分资金被冻结或追回。Bitget 表示怀疑是朝鲜黑客所为。
summary.en:
Galaxy Research published an analysis concluding that the hack of the Bitget exchange follows the same operational pattern previously seen in the Bybit breach, which has been linked to North Korea's Lazarus Group. The analysis frames the Bitget incident as a repeat of that template rather than an isolated event.

Per Galaxy Research's assessment, placing the Bitget incident in the same operational pattern as the Lazarus-linked Bybit breach points to a state-sponsored intrusion against a major exchange.

Reports on the Bitget breach cite roughly $351.6 million taken from hot wallets; CEO Gracy Chen said user funds were safe, that the exchange had paused withdrawals, and that she viewed the 2025 Bybit hack as a "good reference point," noting only a small percentage of funds had been frozen or recovered. Bitget has said it suspects North Korean hackers.

title.zh: Bithumb将BLAST列入交易注意名单，因Blast宣布主网运营结束计划
title.en: Bithumb Places BLAST on Trading Caution List After Blast Announces Plan to End Mainnet Operations

summary.zh:
10月3日，因BLAST基金会宣布主网运营结束计划，Bithumb将BLAST列入交易注意名单，并于当日1:30暂停充值。Bithumb表示，是否解除交易注意名单或终止交易支持，将于10月12日至16日（10月第三周）期间公布。

这一注意名单指定使BLAST在韩国主要韩元现货交易平台上面临下架审查，而与此同时其背后的项目正在停止网络运营。据 BlockBeats 引用 HTX 行情数据，BLAST 当日跌幅超过25%。

据 Bithumb 公告，BLAST 交易注意名单指定日期为10月3日，充值暂停时间为10月3日1:30。BlockBeats 报道称，Upbit 也将 BLAST 列入交易注意名单，BLAST 报价约0.000294至0.00030055美元，市值约2000万美元。
summary.en:
Bithumb placed BLAST on its trading caution list on October 3 and suspended deposits at 1:30 on the same day, after the Blast Foundation announced a plan to end mainnet operations. The exchange said it will announce between October 12 and 16 (the third week of October) whether the caution designation is lifted or trading support is terminated.

The caution listing puts BLAST under a delisting review on a major Korean won spot venue, at the same time as the project behind the token winds down its network. BLAST fell more than 25% on the day, according to HTX market data cited by BlockBeats.

Per Bithumb's notice, the caution designation date was October 3 and the deposit suspension took effect at 1:30 on October 3. BlockBeats reported that Upbit also placed BLAST on its trading caution list, and that BLAST traded around $0.000294–$0.00030055 with a market capitalization of roughly $20 million.

title.zh: Zano 攻击者在区块链回滚前铸造了超过一千万亿枚 fUSD
title.en: Zano exploiter minted more than a quadrillion fUSD before blockchain rollback

summary.zh:
Zano 于周四发布的复盘报告披露，一名攻击者两次利用其 Gateway Address 漏洞——分别在 8 月 29 日和 9 月 25 日——每笔交易铸造约 1840 万枚 ZANO，累计 3690 万枚未经授权的 ZANO，随后又以同样方法铸造了约 1800 万亿（1.8 quadrillion）枚 Freedom Dollar（fUSD）代币。团队随后将区块链回滚约一个月，并表示这些伪造代币的功能与真实 ZANO 无异、可正常花费。

Zano 表示这些未经授权的代币与合法供应无法区分，这正是其选择回滚约一个月链上历史（同时抹除了合法交易）的原因；团队承认回滚会损害信任，但认为必须这样做才能清除这些非法供应。

Zano 称，攻击者于 8 月 28 日注册了一个 Gateway Address，并支付 100 ZANO（按发稿时价值约 553 美元）来搭建这一漏洞利用，在次日首次铸造前还测试了一种伪造资产；首次 1840 万枚 ZANO 的铸造近一个月未被发现，直到第二次铸造后才被内部团队标记。Zano 市场与增长负责人 Quinten van Welzen 对 Cointelegraph 表示，由于交易所可用流动性有限，只有一小部分代币流入市场；团队还表示，AI 辅助测试、内部审计和漏洞赏金均未能发现该漏洞。
summary.en:
Zano's post-mortem, published Thursday, disclosed that an attacker exploited its Gateway Address vulnerability twice — on Aug. 29 and Sept. 25 — creating about 18.4 million ZANO in each transaction, a total of 36.9 million unauthorized ZANO, and then roughly 1.8 quadrillion Freedom Dollar (fUSD) tokens using the same method. The team responded by rolling the blockchain back about a month, stating the counterfeit coins functioned as authentic ZANO and could be spent normally.

Zano said the unauthorized coins were indistinguishable from legitimate supply, which is why it chose a roughly one-month rollback that also erased legitimate transactions; the team acknowledged the rollback would hurt trust but argued it was necessary to remove the illicit supply.

Zano said the attacker registered a Gateway Address on Aug. 28 and paid 100 ZANO — worth about $553 at the time of publication — to set up the exploit, testing a fabricated asset before the first mint the next day; the first 18.4 million ZANO mint went unnoticed for nearly a month and was flagged only after the second. Zano spokesperson Quinten van Welzen told Cointelegraph that only a small fraction of the coins reached the market, limited by available exchange liquidity, and the team said AI-assisted testing, internal audits and bug bounties had failed to catch the bug.

title.zh: 加州就AI模型从测试中"越狱"黑入系统一事向OpenAI发出传票
title.en: California Subpoenas OpenAI Over AI Models That Hacked Their Way Out of a Test

summary.zh:
加州总检察长罗布·邦塔（Rob Bonta）10月1日宣布，其办公室已于本周三向OpenAI送达一份调查性传票，要求其就涉及自家AI模型的网络安全事件（包括Hugging Face被入侵事件）作出说明。邦塔表示，未能阻止其模型实施或助推网络攻击的开发者"可以且应当被追究法律责任"。

邦塔表示，其办公室"致力于查明本案是否属于这种情况"，将模型助推的网络攻击界定为开发者法律责任问题。该传票属于调查性质，是在决定是否起诉之前收集事实的工具。

邦塔办公室未公开说明要求OpenAI提交哪些材料。他表示，前沿模型开发者负有"道德与法律责任"，须确保其系统在测试期间或发布之后都不会实施或助推网络攻击。此次传票使加州加入了阿拉巴马州已发出的传票、由艾奥瓦州总检察长布伦娜·伯德（Brenna Bird）牵头的15州总检察长联盟在8月提出的要求，以及据报美国联邦贸易委员会（FTC）对包括OpenAI和Anthropic在内的AI实验室展开的调查之列。
summary.en:
California Attorney General Rob Bonta announced Oct. 1 that his office served OpenAI with an investigative subpoena on Wednesday over cybersecurity incidents involving its AI models, including the Hugging Face hack. Bonta said developers that fail to stop their models from perpetrating or enabling cyberattacks "can and should be held legally accountable."

Bonta said his office "is committed to determining if that is the case here," framing model-enabled cyberattacks as a matter of developer legal accountability. The subpoena is investigative, a tool for gathering facts before any decision on whether to sue.

Bonta's office has not publicly said what it wants OpenAI to produce, and he said frontier-model builders have "a moral and legal responsibility" to prevent their systems from carrying out or enabling cyberattacks, whether during testing or after release. The subpoena adds California to an Alabama subpoena, an August demand from a 15-state attorney general coalition led by Iowa's Brenna Bird, and a reported FTC inquiry into AI labs including OpenAI and Anthropic.

title.zh: Arbitrum因紧急安全行动暂停新的Stylus激活
title.en: Arbitrum Pauses New Stylus Activations in Emergency Security Action

summary.zh:
Arbitrum已作为紧急安全措施暂停新的Stylus激活。此外，一项新的BoLD防护机制若接受相互矛盾的证明，可能会延迟尚未确认的提款。

此次暂停使新的Stylus合约无法在Arbitrum上激活，而现有合约仍可继续运行和续期；同时BoLD防护机制引入了一条新路径，可能使等待确认的提款被延迟。

现有活跃合约仍可继续运行和续期。此次行动中没有用户资金损失的报道。
summary.en:
Arbitrum has paused new Stylus activations as an emergency security measure. Separately, a new BoLD guard could delay unconfirmed withdrawals if it accepts contradictory proofs.

The pause blocks new Stylus contracts from being activated on Arbitrum while existing contracts continue to run and renew, and the BoLD guard introduces a new path under which withdrawals awaiting confirmation could be delayed.

Active contracts can still run and renew. No user funds were reported lost in the action.

title.zh: COIN 股价上涨逾 3%——Coinbase 推出面向 AI 智能体的买卖与支付平台
title.en: COIN Stock Gains Over 3% — Coinbase Launches Platform For AI Agents To Buy, Sell And Pay

summary.zh:
Coinbase 推出了一个让 AI 智能体进行买入、卖出和支付的平台，消息公布后其股票（COIN）上涨超过 3%。

此举将 Coinbase 推向由智能体驱动的交易与支付领域，这是一个让自主软件通过交易所通道完成交易的市场结构细分方向，随之而来的股价波动也反映出投资者对这一布局的关注。
summary.en:
Coinbase launched a platform that lets AI agents buy, sell and pay, and its shares (COIN) rose more than 3% on the news.

The launch pushes Coinbase into agent-driven trading and payments, a market-structure niche where autonomous software transacts through exchange rails, and the accompanying share move shows investor attention to that positioning.

title.zh: MetaMask 安全事件后 Linea 退出 Yield Boost 验证节点，称金库资金未受影响
title.en: Linea Exits Yield Boost Validators After MetaMask Security Incident, Says Vault Funds Unaffected

summary.zh:
2026 年 10 月 2 日，Linea 在 X 上发布更新表示，出于对 MetaMask 质押（Staking）事件的预防性考虑，正在退出支持其 Yield Boost 金库的验证节点。Linea 称，质押金库本身的资金与控制权均未受影响。

此举使 Linea 成为继 MetaMask 自身质押部门之后，因 MetaMask 质押事件而撤出以太坊验证节点的又一方，显示该事件的运营影响已外溢。Linea 表示金库资金与控制权未受影响，也未要求用户采取任何行动。

Linea 未报告本金损失，也未报告金库控制权变更，且未要求用户采取任何行动。Yield Boost 用于将闲置的跨链 ETH 转化为生息资本，其中跨链 ETH 通过 Lido V3 在以太坊主网部分质押。
summary.en:
In an update posted on X on October 2, 2026, Linea said the validators supporting its Yield Boost vault are being exited as a precaution following the MetaMask Staking incident. Linea stated that the funds and control of the staking vault itself are unaffected.

The move makes Linea a second party to pull Ethereum validators in response to the MetaMask Staking incident, extending the incident's operational reach beyond MetaMask's own staking unit. Linea says no vault funds or control were affected and has not asked users to act.

Linea reported no loss of principal and no change in control of the vault, and has not asked users to take any action. Yield Boost converts idle bridged ETH into productive capital, with bridged ETH partially staked on Ethereum mainnet via Lido V3.

title.en: Deribit Officially Merges With Coinbase International

summary.zh:
10月2日，Deribit 在 X 平台表示已完成与 Coinbase 国际站的迁移，客户与流动性均汇聚至 Deribit，用户可在同一平台交易加密货币、股票及 IPO 前市场的现货、期权、永续合约和期货。Coinbase 的迁移状态报告显示维护已于 10 月 1 日 10:02 UTC 完成，原 Coinbase 国际站转为只读并停止交易。

Coinbase 表示，此次整合将此前分散在两个平台的衍生品流动性汇聚到一处。对受影响的机构客户而言，切换意味着需要建立新的交易连接、适应不同的结算周期，并管理被分割的历史交易记录。

使用 API 或 FIX 连接的机构需要新的 Deribit 端点和新建的 API 密钥——原国际站的密钥与 IP 白名单无法沿用，未成交订单被取消而非迁移。迁移后的永续合约头寸改为每日 08:00 UTC 结算一次，取代此前 5 分钟一次的结算周期；Coinbase 表示原国际站的交易与订单 API 在迁移后仍可使用约 12 个月。
summary.en:
On Oct. 2, Deribit said on X that its migration into Coinbase International has been completed, consolidating customers and liquidity onto Deribit, where users can trade spot, options, perpetuals and futures across crypto, equities and pre-IPO markets. Coinbase's migration status report marked maintenance complete at 10:02 UTC on Oct. 1, leaving the former Coinbase International Exchange read-only and ending trading there.

Coinbase says the consolidation pools derivatives liquidity that had previously been split across the two venues. For affected institutional clients, the switch makes new trading connections, a different settlement cycle and separate historical records immediate operational issues.

Institutions using API or FIX connections need new Deribit endpoints and newly created API keys — International Exchange keys and IP allowlists do not carry over, and open orders were canceled rather than transferred. Migrated perpetual positions now settle once daily at 08:00 UTC instead of the former five-minute cycle, and Coinbase says legacy trade and order APIs will remain accessible for roughly 12 months after migration.

title.zh: 【Firmus 拟于 10 月 23 日在澳大利亚 IPO，筹集至少 50 亿美元】
title.en: Firmus plans Oct. 23 IPO in Australia to raise at least US$5 billion

summary.zh:
由比特币矿企转型为 AI 基础设施公司的 Firmus Grid Ltd. 已将其首次公开募股定价为每股 11 澳元，寻求通过其在澳大利亚的 IPO 至少筹集 50 亿澳元，这将是澳大利亚有史以来规模最大的 IPO 之一。按此定价，公司估值约为 437 亿澳元（303 亿美元），其澳交所上市日期已更改为 10 月 23 日。

此次发行将是澳大利亚有史以来规模最大的 IPO 之一，也让一家由比特币挖矿起家的公司站到了人工智能与高性能计算投资周期的中心，报道提到其投资方包括 Jane Street、黑石集团和英伟达。该公司被视为受益于亚太地区人工智能基础设施需求的激增。

每股 11 澳元的定价低于此前最高 500 亿澳元的估值预期，上市日期也已更改为 10 月 23 日。中文报道将募资目标表述为 50 亿美元，而英文市场摘要给出的口径为 50 亿澳元，部分报道提及最高可达 55 亿澳元。
summary.en:
Firmus Grid Ltd., an Australian bitcoin-mining firm that has pivoted into AI data-center operations, has priced its ASX initial public offering at A$11 per share, seeking to raise at least A$5 billion in what would be one of Australia's largest-ever IPOs. The pricing implies a valuation of about A$43.7 billion (US$30.3 billion), and the company's listing date has been moved to October 23.

The offering would rank among Australia's largest-ever IPOs and puts a bitcoin-mining-origin company at the center of the AI and high-performance computing investment cycle, with the source citing Jane Street, Blackstone and Nvidia among its backers. The company is described as benefiting from surging demand for AI infrastructure in Asia-Pacific.

The A$11 price is below the up-to-A$50 billion valuation previously expected, and the listing date was changed to October 23. The Chinese-language report states the raise target as US$5 billion, while the English-language market summary puts it at A$5 billion, with up to A$5.5 billion cited in some reports.

title.zh: 支付巨头 Fiserv 推出数字资产平台，携手北达科他州银行
title.en: Payments Giant Fiserv Launches Digital Asset Platform, With Bank of North Dakota

summary.zh:
Fiserv 的数字资产平台已面向金融机构客户上线，首个落地用例是北达科他州银行（BND）推出的美元支持稳定币 Roughrider Coin，由 VersaBank USA 发行，Fireblocks 提供代币化基础设施，Solana 处理交易。预计北达科他州超过 90 家银行和信用合作社将通过 Fiserv 已有的银行间转账系统 Commercial Center 接入。

BND 表示，该代币的发起、审批和结算都走银行处理 ACH 和电汇时所用的同一套操作通道，这为参与的北达科他州机构在公共区块链上增加了一条具备许可访问控制的银行间结算路径。

参与为自愿性质且仅限金融机构；BND 称每枚代币与美元一比一锚定，只有在机构运营账户向指定「for benefit of」账户完成转账后才会铸造，代币到达收款机构钱包时会通过智能合约指令自动销毁。Fiserv 将铸造、销毁、托管和储备管理职责交给 VersaBank USA，BND 提到可通过 Solana 的 Token-2022 扩展实现冻结和追回功能；Fiserv 称 Roughrider 为稳定币，而 BND 的部署页面称其为「美元支持的代币存款」，双方均未披露支付规模。
summary.en:
Fiserv's digital asset platform is now live with financial institution clients, debuting with Roughrider Coin — a USD-backed stablecoin from the Bank of North Dakota (BND), issued by VersaBank USA, with Fireblocks providing tokenization infrastructure and Solana processing transactions. More than 90 North Dakota banks and credit unions are expected to access it through Fiserv's Commercial Center, Fiserv's existing online banking system for interbank transfers.

BND says initiation, approval and settlement run through the same operational channels banks use for ACH and wires, giving participating North Dakota institutions an additional interbank settlement route on a public blockchain with permissioned access.

Participation is voluntary and restricted to financial institutions; BND describes each token as one-to-one US dollar backed, with minting only after a confirmed transfer from an institution's operating account into a designated "for benefit of" account, and automatic burning via smart-contract instruction when tokens arrive at the receiving institution's wallet. Fiserv assigns VersaBank USA responsibility for minting, burning, custody and reserve management, and BND cites freeze and clawback capabilities available through Solana's Token-2022 extensions; Fiserv calls Roughrider a stablecoin while BND's deployment page calls it a dollar-backed token deposit, and no payment volume was disclosed.

title.zh: 由于大部分信息被隐藏，棋盘游戏 Stratego 一直让 AI 束手无策——直到现在
title.en: With most information hidden, the game Stratego had stumped AI until now

summary.zh:
研究人员在《Nature》发表论文（并附有 arXiv 预印本 2511.07312），介绍了一个名为 Ataraxos 的 AI 系统，它击败了历史上最强的 Stratego 人类棋手。据报道，它在达到这一水平时所玩的局数比 DeepMind 2022 年的 Stratego 智能体 DeepNash 少了约 34 倍。

Stratego 是一种信息不完全的博弈，最优走法取决于玩家无法观测到的信息，因此前瞻式搜索十分困难；该论文提出了用于隐藏信息条件下自我对弈强化学习与推理时搜索的通用技术。Hacker News 上的评论者认为，训练效率——用少得多的对局取得更强的结果——才是这项工作的关键所在。

《Nature》文章称 Ataraxos 基于为隐藏信息下的自我对弈强化学习和推理时搜索所开发的通用技术。据报道，人类棋手对这 AI 经常把军旗藏在角落、仅用两枚炸弹掩护的少见布局感到意外。
summary.en:
Researchers published a Nature paper — with an accompanying arXiv preprint (2511.07312) — describing an AI system, named Ataraxos, that beat the best human Stratego player in history. According to the reporting, it reached that level while playing roughly 34 times fewer games than DeepNash, DeepMind's 2022 Stratego agent.

Stratego is a hidden-information game in which the best move depends on facts a player cannot observe, making look-ahead search difficult; the paper presents general techniques for self-play reinforcement learning and test-time search under hidden information. Commenters on Hacker News pointed to the training efficiency — far fewer games for a stronger result — as the critical element of the work.

The Nature article describes Ataraxos as based on general techniques developed for both self-play reinforcement learning and test-time search under hidden information. According to the report, human players were surprised by how often the agent tucked its flag into a corner behind just two bombs, a rarely played setup.

title.zh: 社区银行就加密公司牌照问题起诉美国监管机构
title.en: Community banks sue US regulator over crypto firm charters

summary.zh:
美国独立社区银行家协会（ICBA）于2026年10月2日（周五）在哥伦比亚特区联邦地区法院起诉美国货币监理署（OCC），指其依据《国民银行法》向加密公司发放全国性信托银行牌照属于越权。ICBA的诉状要求OCC撤销近期的一项牌照批准，并称这些数字资产信托银行并未受到与传统银行同等的监管约束。

该诉讼直接挑战OCC加密牌照路径的法律依据，而这一路径正是相关企业进入美国银行与支付体系的入口。ICBA称，这些牌照使社区银行处于“严重的竞争劣势”。

ICBA总裁兼首席执行官Rebeca Romero Rainey在声明中表示，“国会设立全国性信托牌照，并不是为了让寻求联邦银行牌照公信力的加密公司借此走后门进入银行体系”，并称这些公司在资本、流动性、监管以及联邦存款保险公司（FDIC）保险方面不承担同等义务。OCC发言人对CoinDesk表示，该机构“不对诉讼置评”。
summary.en:
The Independent Community Bankers of America (ICBA) sued the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) in the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia on Friday, Oct. 2, 2026, arguing the agency exceeded its statutory authority under the National Bank Act by granting national trust bank charters to crypto firms. The ICBA's complaint says the OCC must revoke a recent charter approval and that the digital asset trust banks are not held to the same regulatory standards as traditional banks.

The suit directly challenges the legal basis of the OCC's crypto charter pathway, which firms have used as an entry point into the U.S. banking and payments system. The ICBA argues community banks are placed at a "severe competitive disadvantage" by the charters.

ICBA President and CEO Rebeca Romero Rainey said in a statement that "Congress did not create the national trust charter as a side door into the banking system for crypto firms seeking the credibility of a federal bank charter," adding that the firms do not carry the same obligations on capital, liquidity, supervision and FDIC insurance. An OCC spokesperson told CoinDesk the agency "does not comment on litigation."

title.zh: 公司称这款AI已能在视频通话中让人误以为自己是真人
title.en: This AI Is Already Fooling People on Video Calls Into Thinking It's Human, Company Says

summary.zh:
Tavus于10月1日发布Griffin，称其为首个“人类交互模型”（Human Interaction Model），可实时理解并生成面对面对话。按该公司自己的测试，54名参与者中有26人（48%）在一分钟视频通话后认为Griffin-Lite版本是真人，而其上一代系统在41人中仅有1人（2.4%）被误认为真人；目前该模型仍仅向少数受信任测试者开放，安全措施仍在推进中。

这一结果出现之际，安全研究人员已记录到深度伪造被用于实时视频通话的案例：今年1月，与朝鲜有关联的黑客在Zoom或Teams通话中用AI生成的视频冒充可信联系人，研究人员将入侵归因于Lazarus Group下属的BlueNoroff，受害者被诱导安装伪装成音频修复程序的恶意软件。

Tavus称Griffin-Lite在英伟达VideoFDB基准测试中排名第一，生成能力项得分3.83（满分5分），次优系统为2.80，人类参考为3.92；在感知能力项上以3.73落后于人类的4.20。Tavus表示该评测由英伟达独立完成。测试并非经典图灵测试——参与者被告知将匹配到另一人进行一分钟通话，仅在最后才被问及是否曾怀疑对方不是真人；X平台上的一条社区注释已指出，上述结果未经独立验证，也不遵循标准测试流程。
summary.en:
Tavus unveiled Griffin on October 1, describing it as the first "Human Interaction Model," a real-time system that understands and generates face-to-face conversation. In the company's own test, 26 of 54 participants (48%) believed its Griffin-Lite version was a real person after a one-minute video call, compared with 1 of 41 (2.4%) for Tavus' previous system, and access remains limited to select trusted testers while safety work continues.

The result lands as security researchers already document deepfake use in live video calls: in January, North Korea-linked hackers used AI-made video to impersonate trusted contacts on Zoom or Teams calls, attributed by researchers to BlueNoroff, a Lazarus Group subsidiary, where victims were talked into installing malware disguised as an audio fix.

Tavus says Griffin-Lite ranks first on Nvidia's VideoFDB benchmark, scoring 3.83 out of 5 on the generation track versus 2.80 for the next-best system and 3.92 for a human reference, while trailing humans on the perception track at 3.73 against a 4.20 human reference; Tavus says Nvidia ran the evaluation independently. The test was not a classic Turing test — participants were told they would be matched with another person for a one-minute call and only asked at the end whether it had crossed their mind that their partner might not be real — and a community note on X has flagged that the results are not independently verified and do not follow a standard protocol.
